[EN] A good commander never takes the welfare of his people lightly. This isn't my first mission, not by a long shot, but I'll still ask Velik and Kaia to watch over us.
[ES] Un buen comandante nunca toma a la ligera el bienestar de su gente. Esta no es mi misión inicial, ni mucho menos, pero aun así le pediré a Velik y a Kaia que nos cuiden.
